$comment: Story 4.3b (ADR-153): leaving the hill at first light; the walk west to Indiranagar, where Kumar's horn is.

panels.title: AMBEDKAR NAGAR · 06:10
panels.text: Suresh locks his door and doesn't look back.

panels.title: OLD AIRPORT ROAD · 08:30
panels.text: Nobody on the road but you, your people, and the crows.
